body.statement: For every \(R\ge d+2\) and every \(\zeta\in\mathcal O_{\ell,R}\), the complete proxy-anchored map satisfies \(A_{R,d}=B_{R,d}E_d\) in each \(\theta\in F_{\ell,R}(\zeta)\). If \(\operatorname{rank}(A_{R,d})=\ell+1<N_d\), then every \(f\in\ker A_{R,d}\) annihilates all normalized source columns \(p_0,\ldots,p_{\ell}\) in every member of that nonempty legal fiber.
body.justification: The factorization uses all ternary compatibility equations and isolates the target without reconstructing the latent loading list.
body.gap: Schkoda, Robeva, and Drton recover bivariate loading roots; their construction does not state this complete-tensor kernel identity.
body.consumer: The identity supplies the lower-order recovery primitive for CEId-from-Moments.
